project_name: SOLEKICKS PK - Premium Streetwear Footwear Experience
target_market: Pakistan (Sneakerheads, Urban Streetwear, Runners, Gen-Z / Millennial Style Seekers, inspired by jutay.co / Kith / Bodega / SNKRS)

design_philosophy.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x SWISS EDITORIAL STREETWEAR
core_principles: Product as Kinetic Hero: Pure high-contrast canvas (#0A0A0A deep obsidian text/accents, #FAFAFA warm crisp studio background) allowing sneaker silhouettes and colorways to pop.

High Tension Typography: Heavy condensed grotesk sans (Syne / Archivo / Clash Display feeling with tracking-tighter) for impactful punchy headlines, paired with ultra-clean utilitarian mono/sans for specs, sizes, and pricing.

Motion-First Micro-Interactions: Every card, chip, button, drawer, and banner breathes with kinetic Framer Motion polish (image-swap on hover, quick-size chip select, bounce pulse on wishlist heart, slide-over cart drawer with haptic-feel feedback).

Streetwear Trust & Local Conversion: Transparent Cash on Delivery (COD), 7-Day Hassle-Free Pakistan Exchange, Fast Nationwide Dispatch (Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad 24-48h, rest 2-4 days), Authentic Grade Quality Seals, and photo customer reviews.

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Never use Inter for primary H1/H2 headings. Use strong uppercase font-black with tracking-tighter for streetwear punchiness.
Price tags must display bold PKR currency formatting (e.g., 'Rs. 8,499') with slash through original price (e.g., 'Rs. 13,999') in muted red/gray.
Labels, category pills, and trust flags must use uppercase tracking-[0.15em] with text-[11px] or text-xs.

contrast_strategy.cta_buttons: Solid #0A0A0A with white text or Solid #FF3B30 with white text for High Impact actions.
contrast_strategy.hover_states: Hover background changes must always explicitly set matching high-contrast text color (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-900 hover:text-white).
contrast_strategy.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 border-b border-neutral-200/80 (never pure transparent).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete single-vendor sneaker e-commerce platform with the exact streetwear aesthetic outlined in this file.
Implement clean React state management with persistent LocalStorage for Guest Cart, Wishlist, and Recent Orders so refreshes keep items.
Include pre-seeded catalog with 16+ high-heat streetwear sneaker models across Retro, Lows, Runners, and Slides with realistic PKR pricing and size runs (EU 39 to 46).
Ensure all test IDs (data-testid) defined in this document are strictly attached to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards for end-to-end testing.
Provide interactive mock flows for Checkout, Order Tracking, Customer Reviews with photo uploads simulation, and an accessible Admin Portal.
Ensure the mobile experience has the sticky bottom navigation bar for quick thumb access to Shop, Search, Wishlist, and Cart Drawer.
